reviews.title: Used to be helpful now it’s useless
reviews.text: This used to be a super helpful app for balancing your water, especially if using a frog floater with it. It would tell you exactly how much sodium bicarbonate, hardness increased, etc to add. Just opened it for the new season and it’s completely different and useless. Feels like they let ChatGPT rewrite it. It says to add chlorine before balancing? I’ve never heard this in years of owning a pool, and basic research tells me this is wrong. Just for further info, I filled I up the test info and said yes my chlorine was a normal level. Test results come back and say “ok open the frog another click”. Ummmn that is not going to help me when my tap water is 20ppm hardness and I need to add around a pound or so of calcium carbonate? Idk guess this is the death of what was a genuinely helpful app. Def will be looking up my own calculations and won’t be buying frog floaters going forward.

reviews.title: Needs help!
reviews.text: I’m not sure what use this app is. It doesn’t allow you to upload an image of the test strip. It seemingly serves a limited purpose. I should be able to take a photo of my test strip and it analyzes the colors itself. the bottle already has the same color match chart.

reviews.title: Update is downgrade
reviews.text: It used to tell you what to add and how much to balance your water like ph up or alkalinity increaser. Now it doesn’t. Just says your water isn’t balanced. I liked it much better before

reviews.title: No reminder?
reviews.text: This app claims to tell you when to change your chlor ball. I can’t even find a calendar showing when I put the new ones on. This app is garbage
